sidebar.title: Navigation
today.title: What is coming, and where we stand
today.empty.title: Nothing to show yet
today.empty.body: Upcoming dates and the weekly briefing appear here once your footprint is set and the first sources have been checked.
restricted.title: This page is not available to you
restricted.body: Your role does not include what this page needs. Ask your administrator if you think it should.
notFound.title: Not found
notFound.body: There is nothing at this address in your organisation.
common.errorBody: Check your connection and try again.
problem.network: The server could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
problem.stepUpCancelled: The action was not confirmed, so nothing changed.
auth.signIn.title: Sign in
auth.signIn.lede: Your passkey is the only way in. There is no password.
auth.signIn.waitingHint: Follow the prompt from your browser or device.
auth.signIn.refused: That passkey was not recognised. Try again, or ask your administrator to re-issue your enrolment.
auth.signIn.cancelled: The sign-in was cancelled. Try again when you are ready.
auth.signIn.unsupported: This browser cannot use passkeys. Open bleqq in a current browser on a device with a passkey.
auth.signIn.firstTime: First time here? Enter the code from your invitation
auth.recovery.title: Lost your passkeys?
auth.recovery.lede: There is no reset link and no password to fall back on.
auth.recovery.body: Ask an administrator in your organisation to re-issue your enrolment. You will get a new invitation by email, enter a code once, and create a new passkey.
auth.recovery.lastAdmin: If you are the only administrator, contact bleqq support; they will check who you are before doing the same.
auth.invitation.title: Your invitation
auth.invitation.expired: This invitation is no longer valid. Ask your administrator to send a new one.
auth.invitation.error: We could not open the invitation. Check your connection and try again.
auth.code.title: Enter your code
auth.code.lede: The code was sent to the invited address. It works once and for ten minutes.
auth.code.neutral: If that address is awaiting enrolment, a new code is on its way.
auth.code.locked: Too many attempts. Send a new code and try again.
auth.code.required: Enter your email address and the six-digit code.
auth.code.resent: A new code is on its way to the invited address.
auth.code.reopenLink: To get a code, open the link in your invitation email again.
auth.enrol.title: Create your passkey
auth.enrol.lede: Your device will ask you to confirm with a fingerprint, face or PIN. From now on this is how you sign in.
auth.enrol.waitingHint: Follow the prompt from your browser or device.
auth.enrol.cancelled: The passkey was not created. Try again when you are ready.
auth.enrol.alreadyRegistered: This device already holds a passkey for your account. Use another device, or continue with the one you have.
auth.enrol.secondLede: A second passkey on another device keeps you signed in if you lose the first one. You can also add it later under My passkeys.
auth.enrol.expired: Your enrolment session has ended. Enter your code again to continue.
stepUp.title: Confirm with your passkey
stepUp.body: This action needs a fresh confirmation from you. Your device will ask for a fingerprint, face or PIN.
stepUp.refused: The confirmation did not go through. Try again or cancel.
me.passkeys.title: My passkeys
me.passkeys.lede: Keep at least two, on different devices.
me.passkeys.addLede: Your device will ask you to confirm with a fingerprint, face or PIN.
me.passkeys.removeConfirm: Remove this passkey? You will no longer be able to sign in with it.
me.passkeys.lastPasskey: This is your only passkey. Add another one before removing it.
me.passkeys.name: Name
me.passkeys.emptyBody: Add a passkey to sign in on this device.
me.sessions.title: My sessions
me.sessions.lede: Every device you are signed in on. Sign out the ones you do not recognise.
me.sessions.emptyBody: Sign in on a device to see it here.

admin.members.noInvitationsBody: Invite a person to get started.
admin.members.emptyBody: Invite the first person to your organisation.
admin.members.titleHint: Optional. Shown on the member list.
admin.members.rolesStepUp: Changing roles asks for your passkey.
admin.members.reissueLede: If this person lost every passkey, re-issue their enrolment. Every session ends, every passkey is retired, and they get a new invitation by email.
admin.members.reissueConfirm: Re-issue enrolment? Their sessions end and their passkeys stop working now.
admin.members.reissued: Enrolment re-issued. A new invitation is on its way.
admin.members.deactivateLede: Deactivating ends every session and keeps the history.
admin.members.lastAdmin: This is the last member who can manage members. Give someone else that role first.
admin.members.notFoundBody: There is no such member in your organisation.
admin.roles.title: Roles
admin.roles.lede: A role is a set of permissions. System roles can be renamed, not changed.
admin.roles.retireConfirm: Retire this role? Members who hold it keep their other roles.
admin.roles.usageNotePlaceholder: e.g. Reads cases and saves assessment input
admin.roles.keyRequired: Enter a key and an English label.
admin.apiKeys.title: API keys
admin.apiKeys.lede: For your own integrations. No key can change the library.
admin.apiKeys.newKeyBody: It is not shown again. Store it where your integration keeps secrets.
admin.apiKeys.revokeConfirm: Revoke this key? Anything using it stops working now.
admin.apiKeys.name: Name
admin.apiKeys.expiresHint: Optional. Leave empty for no expiry.
admin.apiKeys.stepUp: Creating a key asks for your passkey.
admin.apiKeys.emptyBody: Create a key when an integration needs one.
